scrcpy_install_guide:
To install it:
• Windows: winget install Genymobile.scrcpy
• Linux: sudo apt install scrcpy (or pacman -S scrcpy)
• macOS: brew install scrcpy

Or download binary from: https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy/releases

help_modal_content:
[bold #7dcfff]File System Navigation:[/
]  • [bold #73daca]↑ / k[/]         Move cursor up
  • [bold #73daca]↓ / j[/]         Move cursor down
  • [bold #73daca]m[/]             Navigate current folder & files table (Middle pane)
  • [bold #73daca]p[/]             Navigate parent folders list (Left pane)
  • [bold #73daca]Enter[/]         Open selected folder or preview
  • [bold #73daca]Backspace[/]     Navigate back to parent folder
  • [bold #73daca]/[/]             Interactive path breadcrumbs & subfolder jump
  • [bold #73daca]s / S[/]         Sort by Name, Size, Type (Invert order)
  • [bold #73daca]v[/]             Real-time screen mirroring with Scrcpy
  • [bold #73daca]h[/]             Return to main menu dashboard
  • [bold #73daca]c[/]             Disconnect active device

[bold #7dcfff]Multiple Selection & Batch:[/
]  • [bold #73daca]Space[/]           Select/deselect file (keeps cursor position)
  • [bold #73daca]a[/]             Select / deselect all files

[bold #7dcfff]File Management & Transfers:[/
]  • [bold #73daca]d[/]             [bold]Download to PC or other Android[/] (single or batch)
  • [bold #73daca]l[/]             [bold]Upload from PC to phone (adb push)[/]
  • [bold #73daca]f[/]             Create new folder (mkdir)
  • [bold #73daca]n[/]             Rename item (mv)
  • [bold #73daca]r[/]             Delete item or all selected items (rm -rf)
  • [bold #73daca]R[/]             Refresh current directory

[bold #7dcfff]Submenu Navigation:[/
]  • [bold #73daca]↑ / ↓ / ← / →[/]   Navigate between buttons and controls
  • [bold #73daca]![/]             Toggle Vim mode (enable j / k navigation)
  • [bold #73daca]Text Input[/]     Press Enter to edit/type, Esc to deselect
  • [bold #73daca]Enter[/]         Confirm or trigger selected control
  • [bold #73daca]Esc[/]           Close submenu (or deselect text input)

[bold #7dcfff]Mouse Interactions:[/
]  • Click [✓] / [ ] checkboxes to select files with mouse
  • Click column headers to sort instantly
  • Click current path header to jump to parent/subfolders
  • Click footer buttons to execute actions

[bold #7dcfff]Thumbnail Engine:[/
]  • High-performance terminal previews powered by [bold #73daca]Raylib-Go[/] (ANSI 24-bit halfblocks)

[bold #7dcfff]Other Features:[/
]  • [bold #73daca]F2[/]            Toggle language (Italiano / English / Español)
  • [bold #73daca]?[/]             Show this help screen
  • [bold #73daca]q[/]             Quit ATUI
